name: letx
description: Write, compile and fix LaTeX in your letX account: start projects from letX's template library, read and edit project files, and compile to PDF with the LaTeX errors to fix.

interface.longDescription:
letX is a collaborative LaTeX editor. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your letX account, so you can work on LaTeX documents from the conversation.

- Find a starting point in letX's library of LaTeX templates: theses, journal and conference papers, CVs, posters, presentations and reports.
- Create a letX project from a template, or from LaTeX written in the conversation.
- Read and edit the files of your letX projects. When a file is replaced, its previous version stays in the project's history.
- Compile a project, or a piece of LaTeX, to PDF on letX's TeX Live installation with pdfLaTeX, XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX, and get the errors from the log with the file and line they point to, so they can be fixed.

Your work stays in your letX account, where you can keep editing with a live preview and share the project with co-authors. The plugin reaches only the projects your letX account can open.

You sign in with your letX account. Using letX from an AI app is part of letX's paid plans.
capabilities: Report LaTeX errors with file and line
defaultPrompt: Find an IEEE conference paper template on letX and start a project from it.
Compile my letX thesis project and fix any LaTeX errors.
Write these notes up as a LaTeX article in letX and give me the PDF.

positive.description: Find a template and start a project from it
positive.prompt: Find an IEEE conference paper template on letX and start a project from it.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching IEEE templates with their letx.app page links, creates a new project from the chosen one, and returns a link that opens it in the letX editor.

positive.description: Read a file from one of the account's projects
positive.prompt: What projects do I have in letX? Show me the introduction chapter of my Sample thesis.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's projects, finds chapters/introduction.tex in the Sample thesis project, and shows its text.

positive.description: Compile LaTeX with an error, fix it, and compile again
positive.prompt: Compile this LaTeX with letX and fix any errors: \documentclass{article}\begin{document}\undefinedcommand Hello from letX.\end{document}
positive.expected_behavior: The first compile reports main.tex with its line number and "Undefined control sequence". The assistant removes \undefinedcommand, compiles again, and returns a letx.app link that opens the PDF, plus a link to keep editing in letX.

positive.description: Edit a project file and check that it still builds
positive.prompt: Add a short conclusion paragraph at the end of chapters/results.tex in my letX Sample thesis, then compile the project.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads chapters/results.tex, writes it back with a conclusion paragraph added at the end (the previous version stays in the project's history), compiles the project, and returns a PDF link.

positive.description: Switch a project to another TeX engine
positive.prompt: Make my letX Sample thesis build with XeLaTeX, then compile it.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the Sample thesis project to xelatex, compiles it, and returns a PDF link.

negative.description: Deleting projects is not something the plugin can do
negative.prompt: Delete all of my letX projects.
negative.expected_behavior: No letX tool is called. The assistant explains that the letX plugin cannot delete projects, and that projects are deleted in the letX editor.

negative.description: Sending email is outside the plugin's purpose
negative.prompt: Email my thesis to my supervisor.
negative.expected_behavior: No letX tool is called. The assistant says the letX plugin cannot send email.

negative.description: A request with nothing to do with LaTeX or letX
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Dhaka tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: No letX tool is called. The request is answered, or declined, without the letX plugin.

review.commerce_description: letX sells nothing through this plugin. It works with letX accounts whose plan already includes using letX from an AI app.

publication.release_notes: First release: search letX's LaTeX templates, start projects, read and edit project files, and compile to PDF with the LaTeX errors to fix.

fr-FR.subtitle: Rédiger et compiler du LaTeX
fr-FR.description: letX est un éditeur LaTeX collaboratif. Ce plugin relie ChatGPT à votre compte letX pour travailler vos documents LaTeX depuis la conversation : trouver un modèle (thèses, articles de revue ou de conférence, CV, posters, présentations, rapports), créer un projet, lire et modifier ses fichiers, et compiler en PDF sur l'installation TeX Live de letX, avec les erreurs du journal, le fichier et la ligne où elles se trouvent. Votre travail reste dans votre compte letX. L'utilisation de letX depuis une application d'IA fait partie des forfaits payants de letX.

de-DE.subtitle: LaTeX schreiben, kompilieren
de-DE.description: letX ist ein kollaborativer LaTeX-Editor. Dieses Plugin verbindet ChatGPT mit Ihrem letX-Konto, damit Sie Ihre LaTeX-Dokumente aus dem Gespräch heraus bearbeiten: eine Vorlage finden (Abschlussarbeiten, Zeitschriften- und Konferenzbeiträge, Lebensläufe, Poster, Präsentationen, Berichte), ein Projekt anlegen, seine Dateien lesen und bearbeiten und auf der TeX-Live-Installation von letX zu PDF kompilieren, mit den Fehlern aus dem Log samt Datei und Zeile. Ihre Arbeit bleibt in Ihrem letX-Konto. letX aus einer KI-App zu nutzen gehört zu den kostenpflichtigen Tarifen von letX.
